ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level contrast; the surface is dominated by low-intensity black and dark-grey pixels, with high-intensity white pixels localized in small clusters representing less than 5% of the total surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The primary surface consists of a contiguous dark-grey/black field. High-contrast white geometric blobs (rosettes) are distributed as follows: a cluster of three spots in the upper-left quadrant, several isolated spots in the central-left region, and sparse spotting along the lower-right trailing margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Defined V-shaped depression with a sharp interior vertex; estimated pixel angle of 45-55 degrees with significant vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency and high-amplitude variations. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits deep, irregular jagged peaks and valleys (scalloping). The left lobe trailing edge features lower-amplitude, more rhythmic serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the lateral boundaries, tapering into acute, upward-oriented tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 12-15 discrete, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters scattered across the dark pigmentation, primarily on the left lobe and lower central fluke.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple distinct vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and deep, jagged indentations along the trailing edge of the right lobe, distinct from natural serration patterns.
other_distinctive_markers: The asymmetry between the extremely jagged right lobe trailing edge and the relatively smoother, more finely serrated left lobe trailing edge.
